messages:
Sanjay Kapoor: Heads-up — Verdigris private/VPC deploy scheduled for Thu 03:00-04:00 UTC. Window confirmed with customer. Planning to do a rolling cutover (control-plane first, then worker pools). Who can own smoke and rollback during the window?

Maya Li: I can take primary smoke. Will be on call for rollback too unless Tom volunteers for DB-related checks.

Olivia Chen: I can cover model-serving validation (latency + correctness). Will run the inference smoke script and sanity prompts.

Tom Reyes: I can own DB migrations and rollback readiness. Quick Q: are we doing zero-downtime schema change or read-only window?

Sanjay Kapoor: No schema changes for Verdigris — it's config-only. Good call for us to still verify DB connectivity and read replicas.

deploy-bot: Reminder: provisioning job for verdigris-vpc will start at 02:50 UTC (10m before window). See run: https://ci.internal/runs/verdigris-1701122334

Maya Li: Smoke checklist draft (short):
- confirm control-plane API healthy
- deploy small test workload to canary workers
- run inference smoke script: `scripts/smoke_inference.sh --profile verdigris`
- run perf check: 95th p99 latency < 250ms for 128 token seq
- verify KV cache warmup on canary
- confirm metrics emitted to console dashboard

Olivia Chen: Adding correctness checks: sample prompts and golden responses (stored in S3). I'll run eval harness and post diffs to the thread.

Tom Reyes: Rollback plan (short):
1) disable traffic to new workers via router flag
2) revert control-plane config commit `infra:v2.3.1` -> `infra:v2.3.0`
3) scale up previous worker ASG to refreeze capacity
4) run quick smoke again to confirm previous state restored

Sanjay Kapoor: Perfect. Can we also set a CI gate that blocks the final traffic shift until Maya marks smoke PASS?

deploy-bot: CI gate `verdigris/canary/approve` added to pipeline. Only users with `eng-platform` permissions can approve.

Maya Li: I'll be in the room 02:40 UTC. If anything looks flaky, I'll mark FAIL and we execute rollback steps.

ops-oncall: I'll monitor infra alerts during the window and have escalation numbers ready. @Tom Reyes and @Maya Li — ping me directly if you need traffic rollback.

Olivia Chen: One more item — post-deploy validation scripts (small) I'll push to the release branch tonight so they're ready to run from the deploy node.

Sanjay Kapoor: Thanks team. Final runbook snippet I'll paste here before the window. If anyone needs to add checks, drop them now. :thumbsup:

Maya Li: tiny nit — include a small command to verify KV cache hit rate:
```
# on canary node
curl -s http://localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit | tail -n1
```

Tom Reyes: ACK. Also will keep DB replica lag < 5s as a hard stop.

Sanjay Kapoor: Last meta — on-call rotation: ops-oncall will escalate to Eng-EM if unplanned rollback required. We'll do postmortem notes in #postmortems only if rollback happens. Otherwise brief deploy note in #general the next day.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: verdigris-vpc-deploy @ Thu 03:00 UTC. Notifying stakeholders: @security, @customer-success-verdigris.

Maya Li: Sounds good. See you in the room.

Olivia Chen: I'll post the golden output link after I upload: s3://redwood-qa/verdigris/goldens/1701122334

Sanjay Kapoor: Closing out — thanks everyone.
